entities.summary: Dane Robert DiLiegro is an American actor and former basketball player. DiLiegro played professional basketball for eight seasons for teams in Italy and Israel. DiLiegro has appeared in productions such as Only Murders in the Building, Running Point, and American Horror Stories.
